caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a green border, containing a pattern of flowers and leaves. The background is a light beige color with a textured appearance resembling small, uneven tiles. Three clusters of pink and red flowers with green and blue leaves are arranged vertically along the center of the rectangle. Smaller buds in shades of pink and blue, as well as thin brown branches with tiny green leaves, extend outward from the main clusters. The color palette mainly consists of beige, green, blue, pink, red, and brown, arranged symmetrically from top to bottom. There is a signature in the lower right corner of the page, and a number is noted in the lower left corner.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
